title: Blitch's brief SAIC tenure, never read in

tellings.quote: stuff so um so yeah uh I was never R into anything at SS

plain: In 2001 John Blitch, who came to the show as a scientist from DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, worked briefly at SAIC, a defense contractor, in Littleton, Colorado, and he says he was never "read in" there, meaning he was never cleared into any secret programme. Blitch tells Michels this from his own experience and names a man called Art Morris in connection with it. It matters because it marks what he did not see from inside: no hidden programme at that company was opened to him.
